tool.name: Beacon2 Service Info
tool.description: describe each beacon and check it against the registry
tool.help:
**What it does**
@HELP_READS@
Reads each selected beacon's informational endpoints -- info, configuration, entry types and its endpoint map -- and compares what the beacon reports with what the tool's provider registry records about it. The report has one row per beacon per checked field, with the recorded value, the observed value, and whether they agree, so a beacon that has changed shows up as data.
The map is read from ``/map``, the endpoint the specification defines, and from ``/beaconMap`` only if ``/map`` is missing.
**What it cannot tell you**
Which kinds of variant a beacon holds. Its metadata describes its interface, not its content: a beacon holding only copy number data and one holding only small variants describe themselves identically.
The tool only reports. It never changes the registry.
